exam_scheme.note: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences National Entrance Test (TISS-NET) was the premier entrance examination conducted by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), a Deemed University funded by the Ministry of Education, Government of India, for admission to its Master of Arts (M.A.), Master of Science (M.Sc.), and Master of Hospital Administration (MHA) programmes across Mumbai, Tuljapur, Hyderabad, and Guwahati campuses. In alignment with national higher education policy, TISS transitioned its post-graduate admissions: admissions to Master of Arts in Human Resource Management & Labour Relations (HRM&LR) and Master of Arts in Organisation Development, Change and Leadership (ODCL) are conducted via the Common Admission Test (CAT) administered by IIMs, while all other postgraduate programmes admit through the Common University Entrance Test for Postgraduates (CUET-PG) administered by NTA. The classical TISS-NET examination pattern comprised a 100-minute Computer Based Test (CBT) with 100 multiple-choice questions (100 marks) across General Awareness (40 Qs), English Proficiency (30 Qs), and Mathematical & Logical Reasoning (30 Qs), with no negative marking.
